# Run book: Generate test data

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/generate-test-data.md) | [Spec](../specs/generate-test-data.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

## Purpose

Show seeded generation: the same type and seed give the same graph, so tests and demos are repeatable.

## Preconditions

- The signed-in user holds the generation.use right (the admin role).

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Generate test data"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/data/generation`:

1. **Generate.** The customer sample and seed 42 are filled in; press Generate. Expect: The generated customer, with its orders and lines, is shown as JSON.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Seed refused | The seed is not a whole number | Enter an integer such as 42 |
| Forbidden | The user lacks the generation.use right | Sign in with the admin role |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Generations (`Generator`).
